name: Canadian Market Persona Supplement (Choice B)
note: Parallel, additive schema for the Canadian persona system (Decision 0020, Option 2 architecture). Does not modify persona/schema/dimensions.json. Intended to be loaded alongside the base 1,290-dim catalog via persona_dimension_catalog.py's catalog_path parameter, once threaded through templating.py. Covers gaps identified against dimensions.json: purchase behavior by product category, consumer-specific psychographics, and media-consumption-by-channel. Values and category boundaries are placeholders for Step 1.2 concept validation, following the structural PATTERN found in Vividata's Opticks 2017 variable dictionary (frequency/type/price-tier/channel decomposition; paired-attitude psychographic themes) and PRIZM5's documented methodology (Environics Analytics, both accessed this session) -- not a reproduction of either vendor's proprietary variable list or observed data. To be rebuilt against real licensed data per TRD-1 Step 1.5 once a license exists; PRIZM5/Vividata's real segment and marginal structure feeds Stage 1 calibration per Decision 0022, not this file's dimension definitions.
indexConvention: Sequential integers 1-99, independent of dimensions.json's own 1-1290 indexing -- this file's dims are additive, not inserted into the base sequence.
reference_sources: Vividata / Opticks Powered by Vividata 2017 - Variables (Environics Analytics) -- structural pattern only (category taxonomy, frequency/type/price/channel decomposition), not the literal variable list
PRIZM Release Notes 2026 (Environics Analytics, public) -- methodology, Social Group axes
StatCan Census Profile 2021 (Open Licence, public) -- see canada-data/statcan/ for pulled samples
Decision 0022 -- scopes PRIZM5/Vividata to calibration input + derived projection layer, not native schema dims
